official_source_documents.canonical_content_text:
Oil prices steady as investors weigh geopolitics, lower US stockpiles

HOUSTON, Oct 21 (Reuters) - Oil prices settled with little change on Wednesday as investors weighed possible progress toward Russia-Ukraine talks against declining US oil stocks and a lack of US-Iran dialogue.

Brent crude futures settled 3 ‌cents, or 0.03% higher, at $108.82 a barrel. US West Texas Intermediate crude closed down 67 cents, or 0.7%, at $97.15.

Both ‌benchmarks had gained more than $2 earlier in the session, with Brent hovering near five-month highs.
